name: muzz-galaxy-app
description: MUZZ GALAXY — Survivor Edition mobile shooter (HTML + Android APK)
author: MUZZ Interactive

scripts.build:android: npx cap sync android && node scripts/apply-android-icons.mjs
scripts.deploy:game: node scripts/build-protected.mjs && npx vercel deploy dist-protected --prod --yes --scope borincanoprs-projects
scripts.deploy:site: node scripts/build-site.mjs && npx vercel deploy dist-site --prod --yes --scope borincanoprs-projects --archive=tgz
